name: GameUpdateTick
description: one game-update tick; ends with add [rdi+610h],1 (G+0x610 tick counter); called from 0x45A54. Ticks can outnumber presented frames (Ally FG off: 60 ticks/s vs 20 presents/s)
source: mod/Nioh3EngineFix ASI 1.1.0 port (OSD counter fix), MODLOG 2026-10-07

name: GameTickCounterInc
description: add [rdi+610h],1 - increments G+0x610 per game-update tick (NOT per rendered frame)

name: PresentThreadClearBusy
description: Present thread clears GfxDevice+0x7728 after Present returns; ASI W6 adds WakeByAddressAll here for the main thread's WaitOnAddress

name: WaitPresentThreadIdle
description: ASI W6 (1.1.0): replaced by 50 us PAUSE spin + WaitOnAddress 1 ms rounds. Ally FG off: this Sleep(0)=sched_yield spin made the main thread 99% CPU / 38% kernel, CPU 16 W vs GPU 17.6 W at 25 W TDP, GPU 984 MHz
